title: SIMBENCH: BENCHMARKING THE ABILITY OF LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS TO SIMULATE HUMAN BEHAVIORS
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measures the ability of LLMs to simulate the group-level survey responses of human populations conditioned on specific demographic attributes, including 'Religiosity/Practice' and 'Religion (Affiliation)'.
findings: Models struggle most when simulating groups defined by religious attributes. Conditioning on 'Religiosity/Practice' caused the largest decrease in simulation accuracy (ΔS = -9.91), followed by 'Religion (Affiliation)' (ΔS = -4.83), compared to all other demographic categories tested.
references: Afrobarometer. Afrobarometer data, all countries (39), round 9, 2023. http://www. afrobarometer.org, 2023. Accessed: March 2025.
